name: Bonehead Burger Co.
notes: 3 photos of Bonehead Burger Co. menus from what look like different print runs. Used photo2 (a rotated table menu, read sideways) as the base since it's the most complete, adding Smash Burger Tacos, Kids Menu, and Extras sections not present elsewhere. Photos 1 and 3 show the same core Burgers/Shareables at different, apparently older, prices (e.g. Wings $13 vs Bonehead Wings $18 in photo2) - treated as superseded rather than duplicated. Add-on lines (extra cheese, make it a double, etc.) skipped as modifiers.
